messages:
maria: Snyk flagged CVE-2026-1234 (glibc) in redwood/base:2026-03-01-canary. Severity HIGH.

jon: Which environments have that tag?

maria: Staging + prod canary (3%). No signs of exploitation. Patch exists in glibc 2.36. Recommend rebuild+sign.

oncall-amber: Not seeing runtime errors tied to this, but I'll watch memory/loader traces.

lee: Proposed steps: 1) rebuild base with patched glibc 2.36 2) sign image using KMS-backed cosign 3) deploy staging canary + vuln scan + smoke tests 4) promote.

maria: Need RBAC: CI SA needs roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on cosign key. Limit to key ring. I'll draft IAM command.

jon: Sec review required before granting sign role. I'll approve once change is recorded in KMS grant tracker.

build-bot: Started build #491 for redwood/base:2026-03-22-rebuild (cmd: gcloud builds submit). Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/491

maria: After build I'll run: cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-key redwood/base:2026-03-22-rebuild

lee: QA for canary: vuln scan, smoke e2e, 30m soak, verify attestation. Rollback to previous signed tag on any fail.

oncall-amber: I'll run the smoke suite and monitor OOM/loader errors. Ping when canary is live.

maria: Also request: enable KMS admin audit logs to logging-redwood-security for 90d and create SIEM alert for unexpected signer grants.

jon: Approved the IAM binding. Added entry to KMS grants sheet and linked this thread.

build-bot: Build #491 succeeded. Artifact pushed: redwood/base:2026-03-22-rebuild

maria: cosign: "Signature appended to redwood/base:2026-03-22-rebuild". Pushing attestation and SBOM.

oncall-amber: Staging canary up; smoketests green; vuln scan shows CVE cleared. No anomalies in logs.

lee: Rolling prod canary (3% traffic) in 10m. Watch latency/errors.

maria: Audit log created: https://logging.internal/entries/attest-987. Ticket SEC-2026-914 created for tracking. Leaving thread open 24h.

jon: Follow-ups: schedule dedicated cluster patch windows and rotate cosign key in 30 days.
